generated.title: Why Does the Earth Shake? (Short Version) | Earthquake Science for Kids
generated.description:
The ground beneath your feet is moving RIGHT NOW! Earth's outer shell is cracked into huge tectonic plates that creep along super slowly, like fingernails grow. Along a fault, their edges get stuck and stress builds up. Then the rocks suddenly slip and let out a burst of energy that travels outward as seismic waves. That's what makes the ground shake!

This is a shorter cut of our earlier "Why Does the Earth Shake?" video.

Part of the Earthquake Science for Kids series from Next Huge Quake.
